scripts.build:ait: vite build --mode ait && node scripts/copy-ait-static.mjs && npx ait build
scripts.build:play: node scripts/assert-play-ads-timeouts.mjs && vite build --mode play && node scripts/copy-ait-static.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:play:test-ads: node scripts/assert-play-ads-timeouts.mjs && VITE_ADMOB_FORCE_TEST=1 vite build --mode play && node scripts/copy-ait-static.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:play:empty-ads: VITE_PLAY_ADS=0 vite build --mode play && node scripts/copy-ait-static.mjs && npx cap sync android
